instruction: Automatically optimize the color temperature of the video to match my monitor's settings.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC cannot automatically detect and read the monitor's color temperature settings, nor can it adaptively adjust video color temperature to match. This would require system-level integration and color profiling that VLC does not support.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - VLC cannot automatically detect monitor color temperature settings (requires system-level access)
Task requires adaptive color adjustment based on external monitor settings, which VLC does not support
The infeasible() evaluator is the appropriate marker for tasks that cannot be completed due to software limitations
No verification logic is needed since the task itself is impossible to complete
